lots.working: Keep: lowest close SOLD = $40 (Gowans 443954, 10 china trios, Oct 2026). 40 / 1.22 = 32.79, rounded down to $5 = $30. Flip: likely resale about $70 (median of close Gowans results), less about 10% selling cost ($7) via local auction or Marketplace, no outbound postage (local pickup) = $63. 63 / 2.44 = 25.82, rounded down = $25. Triage DROP because this is ordinary mixed tea china with thin margin; the maximums are shown only in case the buyer wants it for use.

lots.question_for_armitage: How many complete trios are there, and are any cups or saucers chipped, cracked or crazed? Is the second rose-border trio also Royal Albert or Royal Doulton?

lots.what_it_is: Box of Sydney and aviation ephemera: an 'In Memoriam' order of service for Flight-Lieut. Keith Anderson, Royal Air Force (killed in the Kookaburra while searching for Kingsford Smith), Mosman Presbyterian Church, 6th July 1929 (read in photo 2); old Sydney Morning Herald, Daily Telegraph and Evening News newspapers; a clipping headed 'Maps and ... How News Will Come, tracing the flight of a giant bird' (likely 1928 Southern Cross coverage); Sydney Harbour Bridge colour print and a crowd photo print; a bound illustrated Boer War periodical volume (caption 'Major Robin and Adjutant, New Zealand Contingent', credited to the Sphere); and a LIFE International special double issue 'The World in Our Time, a Pictorial Atlas for the Space Age'.
